notes: αὐτόν is realized as the subject of the recast ὅτι clause; reading it as unrepresented and giving *he* to ἀπεκρίθη is the competing analysis.
οὐκέτι keeps only *after that*, οὐδείς having taken the English negation; οὐδείς heads on *no* with *man* the supplied completion under rule 17.
*any question* completes ἐπερωτῆσαι's English and rides with that verb, headed on *ask*, which is the word the chapter already spends on ἐπερωτάω.
